================================================================================
SAP HANA blocks: DO BEGIN ... END
================================================================================

do begin
  declare x int;
  x = 1;
  select :x from dummy;
end;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name))))

================================================================================
SAP HANA blocks: DO BEGIN ... END and a select
================================================================================

do begin
  declare x int;
  x = 1;
  select :x from dummy;
end;
select 1 from dummy;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
SAP HANA blocks: DO BEGIN with nested blocks
================================================================================

DO BEGIN
  DECLARE i INT = 0;
  WHILE :i < 3 DO
    i = :i + 1;
  END WHILE;
  IF :i = 3 THEN
    BEGIN
      SELECT :i FROM DUMMY;
    END;
  END IF;
END;
SELECT 2 FROM DUMMY;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
SAP HANA blocks: a comment between DO and BEGIN
================================================================================

Do /* a block */ Begin
  x = 1;
End;
select 1 from dummy;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (comment))
  (statement))

================================================================================
SAP HANA blocks: DO that is not DO BEGIN
================================================================================

DO 1 + 1;
DO 'begin';
SELECT 1 FROM DUMMY;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement
    (string))
  (statement))

================================================================================
SAP HANA blocks: a variable right after BEGIN and in a nested block
================================================================================

do begin :body; end;
create procedure p (in a int) as
begin
  if :a > 0 then
    begin
      :stmt;
    end;
  end if;
  select :a from dummy;
end;
select 1 from dummy;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))
